SELECT id, task_type AS taskType, status, created_at AS createdAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, failure_reason AS failureReason, requested_by_user_id AS requestedByUserId FROM background_tasks WHERE
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT j.id, j.job_type AS jobType, j.status, j.created_at AS createdAt, j.updated_at AS updatedAt, j.failure_message AS failureMessage, j.user_id AS userId, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(q.actual_tokens, q.estimated_tokens)), 0) FROM studyroom_generation_calls c JOIN ai_quota_reservations q ON q.request_id = c.quota_request_id WHERE c.job_id = j.id) AS tokens FROM studyroom_generation_jobs j WHERE
ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT quota_date AS quotaDate, user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(COALESCE(actual_tokens, estimated_tokens)) AS tokens FROM ai_quota_reservations WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND quota_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY quota_date, user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'LEASED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE failure_code IS NOT NULL OR UPPER(status) IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD', 'ERROR', 'CANCELED', 'CANCELLED')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) FROM classroom_events e JOIN classroom_sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_quota_reservations WHERE quota_date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(actual_tokens, estimated_tokens)), 0) FROM ai_quota_reservations WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND quota_date = CURRENT_DATE
